title: Master Munda Source Census
description: Federated discovery census. Existing canonical source records remain in the master source register; corpus-specific records remain in their evidence-preserving source bundles; standalone bibliographic discoveries are recorded separately. Reader-facing web-discovery leads are maintained as a separate discovery layer and are not added to the audited source-identity total until deterministic deduplication/canonicalization is complete.

source_registers.counting_rule: Count volume slots with a verified external locator that are not already represented in the canonical master source register.

source_registers.id_policy: new standalone discoveries receive immutable SRC-MMSC identifiers after duplicate checking

source_registers.counting_rule: Discovery leads are searchable but excluded from the audited source-identity total until canonical deduplication confirms whether a lead is a new source, an alternate locator, a catalogue wrapper, or a duplicate.

metrics.note: Audited source-identity count is repository-derived: 14 preserved canonical master-source records + 12 verified external Mundarica volume locators (II-XIII) + 1 standalone MMSC bibliographic discovery = 27. Seventy-seven reader-facing web-discovery leads are tracked separately and deliberately not added to this total until source-identity deduplication is complete. These metrics are not a claim that all Munda/Mundari sources have been discovered. Public, catalogue, index, dataset or media availability is never interpreted as unrestricted reuse permission.

latest_discovery.title: Towards a typology of information structuring in Munda languages

provenance.repository: Formal Approaches to South Asian Languages / University of Konstanz OJS
provenance.caution: Article identity, authorship, publication date and abstract-level Mundari relevance are verified at discovery level only. No grammatical proposition is promoted into MLHKP evidence until exact passage/example/table locators, data provenance, language/corpus scope, rights and contradiction/variant review are established.

web_discovery_layer.boundary: Searchable discovery metadata only; not extracted cultural evidence and not included in audited source-identity totals until canonicalization.
